title: repro record rows carry cost_unknown for an area recorded at the --area-usd cap
goal: repro record writes a cost_unknown row (1 or 0) per area beside cost, so an area that timed out and was recorded at the --area-usd cap is not read as a measured cost

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
ok=any('cost_unknown' in m for m in b.RECORD_METRICS);print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Review gap of SP-ysuvdxsn, rated S3 by the sprint's reviewer.
